'''2008 New Jersey State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 26 July 2008 at the MetLife Building, Lawrenceville, New Jersey.<ref name="sf-21590-310787">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=310787#p310787 NJ States - July 26th], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191808/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21590.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Bill Kafer]] ran the event.<ref name="sf-21590-317511">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317511#p317511 NJ States - July 26th], TacoBill (Bill Kafer), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191808/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21590.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Jan Westergard]] won undefeated (6–0) among eleven players, and runner-up [[Jarad Konsker]] received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-21590-318279">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318279#p318279 NJ States - July 26th], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191808/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21590.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-21590-318333">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318333#p318333 NJ States - July 26th], TacoBill (Bill Kafer), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191808/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21590.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] announced the event on 29 June 2008: an 11 am start, six games and a $7 entry covering event registration and prizes; the winner would receive a virtual card design and a SWCCG binder.<ref name="sf-21590-310787" /> Asked whether a bye would be given out, he answered "yes, like all states events".<ref name="sf-21590-317413">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317413#p317413 NJ States - July 26th], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191808/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21590.html Internet Archive]</ref> On 23 July Kafer wrote that he was "apparently running it" and that [[Greg Shaw]] would be away.<ref name="sf-21590-317511" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' MetLife Building, Lawrenceville, New Jersey<ref name="sf-21590-310787" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 July 2008<ref name="sf-21590-310787" />
* '''Time:''' 11:00 am<ref name="sf-21590-310787" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games<ref name="sf-21590-310787" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $7<ref name="sf-21590-310787" />
* '''Run by:''' [[Bill Kafer]]<ref name="sf-21590-317511" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Jan Westergard]]<ref name="sf-21590-318333" />

== Results ==

On the day of the event Lingrell listed the eleven players as Gogolen, Pinto, J Westergard, Hitt, Simon, Borata, Kafer, El Mundo, Gagliardi, Bordier and Konsker. Lingrell himself lost his first game to Jan Westergard and his second to Kafer and then dropped, and "Joey G." left after one game.<ref name="sf-21590-318279" />

Kafer posted the top five that evening. Westergard went 6–0 and the other four went 4–2, Simon with a timed win; Kafer had started 4–0 and finished third on differential. Konsker received the bye.<ref name="sf-21590-318333" /> Westergard added that Hitt's Light Side deck was QMC.<ref name="sf-21590-318361">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318361#p318361 NJ States - July 26th], Ghosttrain (Jan Westergard), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191808/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21590.html Internet Archive]</ref>
